summary: Array Digital Infrastructure (NYSE:AD) filed an 8-K reporting receipt of a non-binding proposal from majority owner Telephone and Data Systems (TDS) to acquire the ~18.1% of shares it does not already own. TDS holds 81.9% of equity and 95.9% of voting power. A special committee of three independent directors was formed, advised by PJT Partners, to evaluate the proposal. The offer is conditioned on a special committee recommendation and majority-of-minority approval. The 8-K does not state a price, premium, or timeline. Watch for the special committee's determination and any competing interest or appraisal rights risk-arb angle given the controlling shareholder dynamic.
